issues.headline: Lumina OLED firmware freeze accelerating
issues.detail: Cases surged from 4 in May to 18 in June before declining to 8 in July, indicating a significant quality issue affecting recent production batches. This remains the highest-volume emerging problem and warrants immediate investigation into firmware root cause and potential recall scope.

issues.headline: FrostCore compressor noise newly detected
issues.detail: All 5 reported cases appeared in July with no prior history, suggesting either a recent manufacturing defect or newly emerging field failure in this product line. Early monitoring is critical to determine if this represents an isolated batch issue or systemic problem.

issues.headline: SoundWave Bluetooth pairing failures declining after spike
issues.detail: Cases peaked at 7 in June and dropped to 3 in July, indicating the issue may be stabilizing or self-resolving. Continued monitoring is needed to confirm the trend before closing.

issues.headline: AeroSnap X200 battery drain resolved
issues.detail: The June knowledge article publication correlates with elimination of cases in July (0 reported), suggesting the self-service resource successfully addressed customer concerns. This issue can be deprioritized.
